_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
v3.2.123

SysID detailed results, summary and phase markers now agree on independent recorded-probe checks. A cached pass flag cannot turn incomplete or failed measurements into a passing result. The detailed maximum prediction error is recalculated from the retained checks.

Validation: 44 focused regressions per branch; clean layout audits and GUI smoke checks. Firmware, PID, calibration and accepted tuning are unchanged. Controller, cuff-transfer and production SysID qualification remain separate pending bench work.
